clauses.heading: Minimum Average Annual Turnover of the bidder
clauses.quote: Minimum Average Annual Turnover of the bidder (For the last 3 Financial Years) 4 Lakh (s)
clauses.summary: The bidder must have a minimum average annual turnover of Rs 4 lakh over the last three financial years.

clauses.heading: OEM Average Turnover
clauses.quote: OEM Average Turnover (Last 3 Years) 4 Lakh (s) /Years of Past Experience
clauses.summary: The OEM of the offered product must have an average turnover of Rs 4 lakh over the last three years.

clauses.heading: Years of Past Experience Required
clauses.quote: Years of Past Experience Required for same/similar service 3 Year (s)
clauses.summary: Three years of past experience in the same or similar supply is required.

clauses.heading: MSE Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover
clauses.quote: MSE Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover No
clauses.summary: MSEs get no relaxation in the experience or turnover requirements.

clauses.heading: Startup Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover
clauses.quote: Startup Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover No Bid Number GEM/2026/B/8206977
clauses.summary: Startups get no relaxation in the experience or turnover requirements.

clauses.heading: Document required from seller
clauses.quote: Experience Criteria,Past Performance,Bidder Turnover,Certificate (Requested in ATC),OEM Authorization Certificate,OEM Annual Turnover
clauses.summary: Sellers must upload experience, past performance, bidder turnover, OEM authorisation and OEM turnover documents.

clauses.heading: Document required from seller
clauses.quote: In case any bidder is seeking exemption from Experience / Turnover Criteria, the supporting documents to prove his eligibility for exemption must be uploaded for evaluation by the buyer
clauses.summary: Bidders seeking exemption from experience or turnover criteria must upload supporting documents proving eligibility.

clauses.heading: EMD Detail
clauses.quote: Mediation Clause No Bid Details /EMD Detail P /Required No
clauses.summary: No EMD is required for this bid.

clauses.quote: Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid.
clauses.summary: Audited balance sheets or a CA/Cost Accountant certificate of turnover must be uploaded with the bid.

clauses.quote: In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3-year-old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria.
clauses.summary: For bidders under three years old, average turnover of completed financial years since incorporation is considered.

clauses.heading: 2. Experience Criteria
clauses.quote: the Bidder or its OEM of the product offered in the bid {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for number of Financial years as indicated above in the bid document before the bid opening date.
clauses.summary: The bidder or its OEM must have regularly supplied similar products to government bodies or PSUs for the stated number of years.

clauses.heading: 2. Experience Criteria
clauses.quote: Copies of relevant contracts and delivery acceptance certificates like CRAC to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the Financial year.
clauses.summary: Contracts and delivery acceptance certificates for each financial year must be submitted as experience proof.

clauses.heading: 3. OEM Turn Over Criteria
clauses.quote: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document.
clauses.summary: The OEM must meet the minimum average annual turnover stated in the bid for the last three years.

clauses.heading: 7. Past Performance
clauses.quote: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through re-seller(s)} should have supplied same or similar Category Products for 50% of bid quantity, in at least one of the last three Financial years before the bid opening date to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU.
clauses.summary: The bidder or OEM must have supplied at least 50% of the bid quantity of similar products to government or PSU in one of the last three years.

clauses.heading: 7. Past Performance
clauses.quote: Copies of relevant contracts (proving supply of cumulative order quantity in any one financial year) to be submitted along with bid in support of quantity supplied in the relevant Financial year.
clauses.summary: Contracts proving the cumulative supplied quantity in one financial year must be submitted.

clauses.heading: 8 Generic Manufacturer Authorization
clauses.quote: Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid
clauses.summary: Authorised distributors must furnish an OEM authorisation certificate with OEM contact details along with the bid.
